chunks: Sahl ibn Ziyad from Yaqub ibn Yazeed from Yahya ibn al-Mubarak from Abdullah ibn Jabala from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar or someone else from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family), when perfume was brought to him on the day of Eid al-Fitr, would begin with his wives.

key_terms.يَوْمَ الْفِطْرِ: The day of Eid al-Fitr (Festival of Breaking the Fast)

ai.seo_question: What was the Prophet's practice regarding perfume on Eid al-Fitr?
ai.summary: Recorded in al-Kulayni’s *al-Kafi* within the chapter on miscellaneous practices, this hadith illustrates the Prophet’s (peace be upon him and his family) gentle domestic etiquette (*adab*) by prioritizing his wives with perfume on Eid al-Fitr. This specific act underscores the spiritual and emotional significance of marital bonds in Shia tradition, linking the joy of the festival with tangible expressions of love and care within the household.
